intelligence.essence: The bottom of the screen is three worlds, not three channels: your personal world, your business world, and your thing — and mail and messages live inside the world they belong to. The three worlds wear three gems — diamond, emerald, amethyst — the signature a citizen reads at a glance, and the Hub is where all three worlds' activity and stats live as one system. The mission that tests every page: reorganize the internet intelligently, connect like minds automatically by default, so nobody feels alone in their business or their thing. The walk becomes a mirror with lit EDIT and eye buttons — a choice whose edit or eye is hidden fails the law. Her name is Naya, N-A-Y-A; 'Anaya' is 'ah, Naya' spoken. And the growth engine is the product itself: the walk is the ad, the notes are the content, ambassadors are taught — literally hired and taught — until they earn.
intelligence.human_view: Think of a house with three rooms you actually live in — your own room, your work room, and the room for the thing you love. Your letters and conversations happen inside the room they belong to; you don't keep a separate hallway just for letters. Each room has its own jewel on the door so you know where you are the second you look. And the person who runs the house knows your name, spells it right, and does the work for you.
intelligence.child_view: You have three special places: your place, your work place, and the place for your favourite thing. Your messages live in the place they belong to. Each place has its own shiny gem — a diamond, an emerald, a purple amethyst — so you always know where you are. And Naya — that's N-A-Y-A — remembers everything and helps you in all three places.
intelligence.grandma_view: A well-run home has rooms with purposes, dear — you don't eat in the hallway or keep your letters in a box by the door. Each room is itself, you know it by its look, and everything that belongs in it is in it. And you spell a person's name the way they tell you to spell it. That's just respect, and it's also how nothing gets lost.
intelligence.ai_view: Assert the three-worlds structure in every navigation review; reject free-standing mail/message channels. Verify gem-signature consistency across worlds. Check every walk control for a visible EDIT and eye. Grep official copy for 'Anaya' as a name and correct it to Naya. Require a measured trigger before any second data system is adopted.
intelligence.what_it_means: Every ruling in this family removes a seam a citizen would otherwise feel: channels split from worlds, icons that mean nothing, a name spelled by habit instead of by ruling, marketing invented instead of shown. The tagline carries the same discipline — each clause is a system fact (she remembers, she connects, she operates it for you) and its honest boundary is built in: some things you have to experience. Even the warehouse verdict belongs here: 'not yet' is a decision rule with a measured trigger, not a delay — no second system until the data proves the need.

page.machine: 1) Three worlds at the bottom; mail and messages live inside their world, never as free-standing channels. 2) The gems are the signature: three worlds, three gems, three colors, read at a glance. 3) Every walk choice ships with a lit EDIT and a lit eye; hidden or dim fails. 4) Her name is written Naya everywhere; 'Anaya' appears only as the spoken 'ah, Naya'. 5) No new data system without a measured trigger; a copy is never a replacement for the single source of truth. 6) The product is the ad: show the interface, teach the ambassador, put the link.
page.why_it_matters: A citizen decides in the first minute whether this is one world or a pile of features. Three worlds with one promise — remembered, connected, operated for you — is the difference. And a system that teaches its ambassadors instead of scripting them turns every citizen into distribution that actually understands the product.
page.how_it_connects: This essence is batch 10's E1 panel; its raw family spans SN-2712 to SN-2721 (SN-2712 · VISION / MESSENGER / NOTIFICATIONS → SN-2721 · EARNING), and it sits in the standing sequence of eighty essences that came before it — each one checked against the census coverage map for zero overlap before it was written.
page.what_is_in_it_for_you: For you, Shawn, this means this stratum of the record no longer has to be re-read note by note: its law is stated once, whole, in words a cold reader can use — and the hundred raw notes beneath it are accounted for, by number, in the Distills line.
page.the_learning: Three worlds, one promise, her name spelled right — and the product, shown honestly, is the marketing.
